observations.summary: Reuters reports Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi ordered additional security forces around Jurf al-Sakhar and preparations for government troop entry amid an oil-smuggling crackdown targeting a network Iraqi officials attribute to Kataib Hezbollah. Reuters reports nine senior security and oil officials dismissed. The timing of the underlying orders is not established; no entry or armed confrontation confirmed. Kataib Hezbollah denies involvement in smuggling.
observations.title: Iraqi government orders force preparations near Kataib Hezbollah stronghold
